name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3189: Two label fixes from the read-only audit and Grok eyes. The cousin ribbon printed WINDOWS to a Linux box because that word is the storage contract for everything that is not a Mac, so it now names the machine it is actually on without minting a third world. And the vault register button carried a count from a proposal that may have been graded in a process that no longer exists, while the caption above it already said so.
